## At a glance
::: {.summary-grid}
Question
:   How do returns to education differ by union membership?

Data
:   `nlsw88` · NLSW 1988 extract, 2,246 women

Methods
:   OLS on log wages with an education × union interaction; predictive margins

Finding
:   One sentence on the main result.
:::
:::



## Data and model

Each Stata chunk runs in a fresh session, so `collectcode=TRUE` carries the
data and estimates forward to later chunks.


::: {.cell collectcode='true'}

```{.stata .cell-code}
sysuse nlsw88, clear
gen lnwage = ln(wage)
regress lnwage c.grade##i.union c.ttl_exp##c.ttl_exp i.race, vce(robust)
```
:::


## Visualization

Stata graphs are exported to PNG, then shown with ordinary Markdown.


::: {.cell}

```{.stata .cell-code}
margins union, at(grade = (8(2)18))
marginsplot, recast(line) recastci(rarea) ciopts(color(%30)) ///
    title("") ytitle("Predicted log wage") xtitle("Years of schooling") ///
    legend(order(3 "Non-union" 4 "Union") pos(6) rows(1)) scheme(s2color)
graph export "margins.png", replace width(1600)
```
:::


![Predicted log wages by schooling and union status (95% CI).](margins.png){#fig-margins width=85%}
